content: {"rulings":[{"chargeId":"c1","decision":"convicted","reason":"The witness test demonstrates that removing the decodeURIComponent call causes double-encoding of already-percent-encoded query parameters (e.g., %2520 becomes %252520 instead of staying %2520). The defense acknowledges the decode was a workaround but offers no alternative fix; the regression is unintended and a maintainer would want it resolved before merge."}]}
